name: Play Outside
description: Run around, explore the neighborhood, climb trees.
flavorText: You spent the afternoon running around. Your legs feel stronger.

name: Read Books
description: Settle in with a good book. Quiet time for imagination.
flavorText: You got lost in a story. Your imagination is alive.

name: Help with Chores
description: Pitch in around the house. Build responsibility.
flavorText: You helped out without complaining. Your parents were impressed.

name: Play Catch
description: Toss a ball back and forth in the yard.
flavorText: Your throws are getting more accurate. Your hand-eye coordination is improving.

name: Sleep In
description: Rest and recharge. Good for growing bodies.
flavorText: After a full night of sleep, you feel refreshed and ready for anything.
